description: This file contains a utility class 'TokenizeTool' for encrypting strings using AES encryption in ECB mode with PKCS5Padding. It initializes a symmetric key using DES algorithm on class load, and provides a static method to tokenize (encrypt) input strings.

classes.name: TokenizeTool
classes.description: Utility class providing static method to encrypt strings using AES.

methods.name: tokenizeString
methods.description: Encrypts the provided string using AES encryption and returns the ciphertext as a string.
